title: Control decoded quantum error by unsafe occupation for arbitrary local HP/TA terms
statement: Let O_j=D^*(sigma_j),P a projector with[O_j,A_X]P=0 for every permitted local operator and j=x,y,z, Q=I-P, and q(s)=sup_logical_states Tr[Q exp(sK)E(rho)]. Local HP/TA operator-sum representations and trace annihilation imply K_X^*(O_j)P=0; Hermiticity gives K_X^*(O_j)=Q K_X^*(O_j)Q. With M=sum ||K_X^*||infinity-to-infinity, integrate the three logical Bloch components and the factor-three lemma to obtain ||D exp(tK)E-id||diamond<=3sqrt(3) M integral_0^t q(s) ds. Individual terms need not be GKLS or Pauli. The useful exponentially small q(s) remains an unproved dynamical premise.
